data.narrative:
Unconventional AI is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Naveen Rao, Michael Carbin, Sara Achour, and MeeLan Lee, having raised $475M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. Using $475M in total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-Series A progression yields $1.2B. Peer-Median analysis was not executable: while 13 same-sector companies exist, no cohort of three or more same-stage or adjacent-stage peers could be isolated. Public-Comp Anchoring could not proceed absent revenue disclosure, which is standard for private companies; public semiconductor multiples show a median P/S of 18.9x across the three tickers, but remain inapplicable without target revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B (low) to $1.4B (high), centered at $1.2B. This range reflects substantial uncertainty. The single method underpinning the estimate carries inherent volatility in stage-progression multipliers. Absence of narrow peer benchmarking and revenue data prevents triangulation and leaves key questions unresolved regarding comparable burn rate, technical differentiation, and market timing relative to peers. Additional revenue or unit-economics data would strengthen conviction.
